نعتبر (form VIII)
# نَعْتَبِرُ (naʕtabiru) /naʕ.ta.bi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# نُعْتَبَرُ (nuʕtabaru) /nuʕ.ta.ba.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# نَعْتَبِرَ (naʕtabira) /naʕ.ta.bi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# نُعْتَبَرَ (nuʕtabara) /nuʕ.ta.ba.ra/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
